# Invitation: Place holder to talk to GB. @ Fri Oct 2, 2026 11:35am - 12:15pm (EDT) (null)
Date: 2026-10-02 | Duration: 45.029998779296875m

## Summary
The discussion focused on scalability risks as experiment imports add millions of rows to a warehouse containing approximately 200 billion rows, with potential effects on experiment analysis, custom reports, and compute. Performance was prioritized over cost measurement, while Snowflake’s finite budget remained a constraint. Proposed improvements included incremental refresh using reliable watermarks, pre-aggregated tables, clustering keys, timestamp filtering, transient or temporary processing, newer warehouse types, and query tagging. Incremental refresh is complicated by multiple data domains, missing ingestion or received timestamps, late-arriving data, and the need to scan forward from a watermark without repeatedly rescanning history. Pre-aggregation must preserve exposure details, health checks, interaction analysis, flexible date ranges, and custom reports. Better query-cost attribution, usage forecasting, data retention options, and value-based capacity decisions were also discussed. Angela will arrange a session next week with Manoj and Zhongjiong, with GrowthBook and Snowflake specialists joining as needed.

## Keywords
Snowflake scalability, Incremental refresh, Watermark timestamps, Query tagging, Pre-aggregation, Experiment analytics
